name: cines_list_cinemas
title: List my cinemas
description: List the user's Cinépolis cinemas (regular and VIP) with distance from home and seating rules.

name: cines_listings
title: Listings for cinemas and a date or date range
description: Movies and showtimes at the user's cinemas for a date, or for a date range ('¿qué hay hasta el domingo?' → date:'hoy', dateTo:'domingo'). `cinema` accepts names like 'toreo', 'toreo vip', 'miyana' or 'todos'; default: the home cinema for one day, ALL the user's cinemas for a range. One day returns times; a range returns one line per movie (dates, cinemas, languages) — call again with one cinema and date for times. Languages: SUB=subtitulada, ESP=doblada.

cinema.description: Cinema name(s) or id(s), or 'todos'; default: home cinema (one day) / all cinemas (range)

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, hoy, mañana, or weekday; default today (start of the range)

dateTo.description: Last date of a range (YYYY-MM-DD, mañana, weekday, e.g. 'domingo' for 'hasta el domingo')

days.description: Range length in days starting at `date` (alternative to dateTo)

name: cines_find_movie
title: Where and when my cinemas show a movie
description: Find a movie by title (Spanish, English or original; partial, accents and '(TBC)'-style suffixes ignored) across ALL the user's cinemas over a date range (default today + 7 days, extended to the furthest date Cinépolis has published, max 21). Returns each cinema with its first date and all dates. Pass `altTitles` with other names you know for it. If `found` is false, the result says exactly which range and cinemas were searched: never claim it is not showing outside that range.

movie.description: Movie title, partial title, or id

altTitles.description: Other titles the user may mean (English/original/Japanese/Spanish), e.g. ['Your Name','Kimi no Na wa']

cinema.description: Restrict to these cinemas; default all of the user's cinemas

dateTo.description: Last date of a range (YYYY-MM-DD, mañana, weekday, e.g. 'domingo' for 'hasta el domingo')

days.description: Range length in days starting at `date` (alternative to dateTo)

name: cines_showtimes
title: Showtimes for a movie
description: All upcoming showtimes for a movie at the user's cinemas (or the given ones), optionally for one date or a range (date + dateTo/days), language or format. Use cines_best_showtime to recommend one.

altTitles.description: Other titles the user may mean (English/original/Japanese/Spanish), e.g. ['Your Name','Kimi no Na wa']

cinema.description: Name(s) or id(s), comma separated; default all of the user's cinemas

date.description: One date, or the start of a range with dateTo/days; default: all published dates

dateTo.description: Last date of a range (YYYY-MM-DD, mañana, weekday, e.g. 'domingo' for 'hasta el domingo')

days.description: Range length in days starting at `date` (alternative to dateTo)

format.description: 2D, 3D, 4DX, IMAX, XE, SCREENX, VIP or REGULAR

name: cines_best_showtime
title: Recommend the best showtime
description: Recommend the best showtime for a movie plus 2 alternatives, using the user's rules: closest cinema, subtitled over dubbed (dubbed only if no subtitled option), inside the time window, regular/VIP before premium formats. Includes warnings (4DX, VIP price, B15/C, special screenings) and ticket prices (default 'Admision General'; cheaper promos are only mentioned).

altTitles.description: Other titles the user may mean (English/original/Japanese/Spanish), e.g. ['Your Name','Kimi no Na wa']

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, hoy, mañana or weekday; default today

format.description: Require a format: IMAX, 4DX, XE, SCREENX, 3D or REGULAR

cinema.description: Restrict to these cinemas (names or ids)

name: cines_upcoming
title: Upcoming releases and presales
description: Movies coming soon to the user's cinemas, with release dates, rating and whether presale (preventa) is open.

days.description: Only releases within this many days; default 45

name: cines_seat_map
title: Seat map with proposed seats
description: Live seat map for a showtime with the best seats proposed for the party (regular rooms: center, middle-to-lower rows; VIP/IMAX/premium: center, upper rows; groups together; prefers not to leave single empty seats). Returns `imageUrl` (PNG to send to the user), the proposal like ['F7','F8'] and availability counts. Does NOT hold seats. The user may reply with other seats; check them with cines_validate_seats.

wheelchair.description: Allow wheelchair spaces (only if the user needs them)

name: cines_validate_seats
title: Validate the user's seat choice
description: Check seats the user typed (e.g. 'F7,F8') against the live map: they exist, are free, match the ticket count, sit together, and warns if a single empty seat would be left (allowed in Mexico). Returns errors/warnings and a preview `imageUrl` with the choice highlighted. Does NOT hold seats.
